H400.def: from «0398»; food:--eating, food, meal(-time), meat, prey, victuals.

H403.def: from «03559» (compare «03651»); firmly; figuratively, surely; also (advers.) but:--but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily.

H404.def: a primitive root; apparently meaning to curve (as with a burden); to urge:--crave.

H405.def: from «0404»; a load; by implication, a stroke (others dignity):--hand.

H406.et: from an unused root meaning to dig

H407.def: from «03784»; fascination; Acshaph, a place in Palestine:--Achshaph.

H411.et: a demonstrative particle (only in a plural sense)
H411.def: a demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense) these or those:--these, those. Compare «0428».

H413.def: (but only used in the shortened constructive form sel {el}); a primitive particle; properly, denoting motion towards, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, i.e. near, with or among; often in general, to:--about, according to ,after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, × hath, in(- to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

H416.def: from «0410» and «01008»; the God of Bethel; El-Bethel, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob:--El-beth-el.

H432.def: probably from «0408»; nay, i.e. (softened) if:--but if, yea though.

H433.def: probably prolonged (emphat.) from «0410»; a deity or the Deity:--God, god. See «0430».

H434.def: for «0457»; good for nothing:--thing of nought.

H435.def: probably of foreign derivation; Elul, the sixth Jewish month:--Elul.

H436.def: prolonged from «0352»; an oak or other strong tree:--plain. See also «0356».

H438.def: the same as «0437»; Allon, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine:--Allon.

H440.def: or rather (shortened) oEloniy {ay-lo-nee'}; patron from «0438»; an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon:--Elonites.

H441.def: or (shortened) talluph {al-loof'}; from «0502»; familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle):--captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox.

H442.def: of uncertain derivation; Alush, a place in the Desert:--Alush.

H443.def: from «0410» and «02064»; God has bestowed; Elzabad, the name of two Israelites:--Elzabad.

H448.def: or (contraction) ;Eliyathah {el-ee-yaw- thaw'}; from «0410» and «0225»; God of (his) consent; Eliathah, an Israelite:-- Eliathah.

H451.et: from (0422) (in the original sense of strength)

H455.def: from «0410» and «02244»; God will hide; Eljachba, an Israelite:--Eliahbah.

H456.def: from «0410» and «02779»; God of autumn; Elichoreph, an Israelite:--Elihoreph.

H457.def: apparently from «0408»; good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity; specifically an idol:--idol, no value, thing of nought.

H458.def: from «0410» and «04428»; God of (the) king; Elimelek, an Israelite:--Elimelech.

H459.def: (Aramaic) or shorter oillen {il-lane'}; prolonged from «0412»; these:--the, these.

H460.def: from «0410» and «03254»; God (is) gatherer; Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites:--Eliasaph.

H461.def: from «0410» and «05828»; God of help; Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites:--Eliezer.

H462.def: probably contracted for «0454»; Elienai, an Israelite:--Elienai.

H463.def: from «0410» and «05971»; God of (the) people; Eliam, an Israelite:--Eliam.

H464.def: from «0410» and «06337»; God of gold; Eliphaz, the name of one of Job's friends, and of a son of Esau:--Eliphaz.

H465.def: from «0410» and «06419»; God of judgment; Eliphal, an Israelite:--Eliphal.

H466.def: from «0410» and «06395»; God of his distinction; Eliphelehu, an Israelite:--Elipheleh.

H472.def: from «0410» and «07651» (in the sense of «07650»); God of (the) oath; Elisheba, the wife of Aaron:--Elisheba.

H473.def: probably of foreign derivation; Elishah, a son of Javan:--Elishah.

H474.def: from «0410» and «07769»; God of supplication (or of riches); Elishua, the son of King David:--Elishua.

H476.def: from «0410» and «08085»; God of hearing; Elishama, the name of seven Israelites:--Elishama.

H477.def: contracted for «0474».; Elisha, the famous prophet:--Elisha.

H478.def: from «0410» and «08199»; God of judgment; Elishaphat, an Israelite:--Elishaphat.

H488.def: prolonged from «0481» in the sense of bereavement; discarded (as a divorced person):--forsaken.

H491.def: feminine of «0488»; concrete, a widow; abstract, widowhood:--widow, widowhood.
